# target=local-loopback
table proposals: owner=postgres
table tasks: owner=postgres
rls proposals: enabled=true forced=false
rls tasks: enabled=true forced=false
column proposals #01 id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
column proposals #02 task_id uuid NOT NULL
column proposals #03 body text NOT NULL
column proposals #04 status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'needs_authorization'::text
column proposals #05 frozen_at timestamp with time zone
column proposals #06 created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
column tasks #01 id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
column tasks #02 title text NOT NULL
column tasks #03 description text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
column tasks #04 status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'todo'::text
column tasks #05 raci jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
column tasks #06 links jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb
column tasks #07 created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
column tasks #08 updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
constraint proposals.proposals_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint proposals.proposals_status_check: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['needs_authorization'::text, 'authorized'::text, 'bounced'::text, 'denied'::text])))
constraint proposals.proposals_task_id_fkey: FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES public.tasks(id)
constraint tasks.tasks_description_check: CHECK ((char_length(description) <= 600))
constraint tasks.tasks_pkey: PRIMARY KEY (id)
index proposals.proposals_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX proposals_pkey ON public.proposals USING btree (id)
index tasks.tasks_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tasks_pkey ON public.tasks USING btree (id)
policy proposals.service_role_only: PERMISSIVE ALL to service_role using (true) with check (true)
policy tasks.service_role_only: PERMISSIVE ALL to service_role using (true) with check (true)
grant proposals: anon DELETE
grant proposals: anon INSERT
grant proposals: anon MAINTAIN
grant proposals: anon REFERENCES
grant proposals: anon SELECT
grant proposals: anon TRIGGER
grant proposals: anon TRUNCATE
grant proposals: anon UPDATE
grant proposals: authenticated DELETE
grant proposals: authenticated INSERT
grant proposals: authenticated MAINTAIN
grant proposals: authenticated REFERENCES
grant proposals: authenticated SELECT
grant proposals: authenticated TRIGGER
grant proposals: authenticated TRUNCATE
grant proposals: authenticated UPDATE
grant proposals: postgres DELETE
grant proposals: postgres INSERT
grant proposals: postgres MAINTAIN
grant proposals: postgres REFERENCES
grant proposals: postgres SELECT
grant proposals: postgres TRIGGER
grant proposals: postgres TRUNCATE
grant proposals: postgres UPDATE

grant proposals: service_role INSERT
grant proposals: service_role MAINTAIN
grant proposals: service_role REFERENCES

grant proposals: service_role UPDATE
